objective: Test whether Bybit-native BTCUSDT/ETHUSDT absolute adaptive round-number crossings, conditioned on causal post-cross acceptance or rejection and aggressor flow, produce repeatable after-cost taker markouts large enough to justify broader reconstruction before any 2024 opening.
scope: Sparse pre-2024 fatal screen using six immutable Bybit public trade dates. The state is absolute significant-digit price-grid crossing plus causally observed post-cross location and aggressor flow. Entry is the first later trade after fixed confirmation and 100 ms latency; one global slot and 12/18/24bp all-in cost replay are enforced. No BBO/depth claim, account-ranking claim, later-period opening or order path is permitted at this stage.
non_overlap: event-tape burst segments trades by quiet-time episodes and pace; this claim starts only from absolute price-grid boundary crossings
movement-hazard OCO is direction-neutral two-sided conditional-order placement; this claim waits for a single confirmed direction and uses taker markouts
auction-profile uses prior-session volume-at-price POC/value areas; this claim uses no session profile or volume-at-price construction
liquidation-refill, cross-venue, option-surface, collateral, dated-futures and positioning states are excluded
reported L2 maker spread-capture and ordinary one-minute flow-impact dependencies are not retuned
